title: Notice regarding Cycling Test under Regular Mazdoor Recruitment Examination, 2025 (Advertisement No. PHC/01/2025). 04-Dec-2025 04-Dec-2025 View...

FULL TEXT:
REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.- 92/R&A Dated: 04th December, 2025
This is for information to all concerned that Cycling Test under the Regular Mazdoor
Recruitment Examination, 2025 (Advertisement No. PHC/01/2025) shall be held from
10.12.2025 to 12.12.2025 at a test ground situated in PATNA. Orthopedically Handicapped
(OH) candidates are exempted from appearing in the Cycling test.
Admit cards for eligible candidates will be made available on the official website of the
High Court: https://patnahighcourt.gov.in, latest by two (02) days prior to the commencement of
the test. Candidate may download their admit cards from the designated link, to be made
available on the Court’s website, using login credentials and are advised to carefully go through
the details mentioned therein.
The eligible candidates will also be intimated through SMS/ e-mail on their registered
mobile number/ e-mail ID in this regard. Date, Slot and Venue of test once allotted to the
candidates shall be final and no communication regarding changes shall be entertained. Admit
cards will not be sent to the candidates separately through any other mode.
Cycles will be provided at the Cycling Test Ground; candidates need not bring
their own.
No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the examination.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website:
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in regularly for further details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
